title: Single-Pass PTX Bitmask Accumulation & Warp-Level Traversal

claims.assertion: Traditional filtering requires two scans: one to count qualifying elements for shared memory slot allocation and a second to write them. DeepSelect eliminates the second scan by generating a 32-bit bitmask during the count phase using PTX instructions (set.s32.bf16x2, prmt.b32, dp4a.s32.s32), and subsequent placement traverses candidate indices via hardware __ffs(mask) and bit clearing mask &= mask - 1u.
